story: Raju & Chinni kuda pattinchu: Robo Raju appears with a basket full of fruits, and they find out Meena has arranged a surprise fruit party in the park!
script: Scene opens with Raju and Chinni riding their bikes in a park. Raju (in a casual tone - 'Vishy, vishy') says "Enduku ra mechanical text books chustav, update avvu!" Chinni laughs and they keep riding. Suddenly, Robo Raju's music plays and he appears with a basket full of colorful fruits. Raju exclaims, "Wow! Meena nee surprise party e pellinchu!" Chinni and Robo Raju go towards the music. Chinni (excited) says "Wow! Me party!" Meena appears with a big banner that reads "Meena's Fruit Party". They all cheer and the scene ends with the group smiling and holding fruits.
character_prompt: Create Robo Raju: 12-year-old boy, brown skin tone with bright blue eyes, curly black hair styled in a fade haircut. He wears a pair of neon green sunglasses, a casual yellow t-shirt with a cartoon robot design, and a pair of faded blue jeans. Expression: cheerful, energetic, a mix of excitement and surprise. 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, Pixar-style animation, cinematic lighting. Color scheme: bright and vibrant with lots of blues and yellows.
animation_prompts: Scene 1: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. 3D animated cartoon style. Close-up shot of Raju and Chinni riding their bicycles in a park with the wind blowing in their hair. No background objects should be blurred.

Scene 2: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. 3D animated cartoon style. Smooth pan showing Robo Raju appearing with a basket full of fruits in a dramatic, slow-motion entrance. Use colorful and eye-catching animation for the fruits to emphasize their excitement.

Scene 3: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. 3D animated cartoon style. Wide shot of the group - Raju, Chinni, and Robo Raju - smiling and holding fruits, with Meena standing behind them holding a big banner.
Scene 4: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. 3D animated cartoon style. Close-up shot of the party banner with Meena's voice saying "Meena's Fruit Party" in bold, animated font.
Scene 5: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. 3D animated cartoon style. Quick cut of the group having fun eating fruits, running around, and smiling at each other. No background objects should be blurred.
Scene 6: 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. 3D animated cartoon style. Final shot of the group sitting in a circle, smiling, and holding hands with the sun setting in the background.
